PROP formula sheet On-design cycle analysis, propellers and turbomachinery

T1 on-design analysis (turbojet, turbofan, turboprop, propfan), T2 compressors, T3 turbines; exercises 1A-3B. The partial allows a 2-sheet cheat sheet (4 faces, free format, handed in): this PDF takes 2 A4 faces, leaving 2 for your own worked templates (1A station table, 2A/3A triangles and T-s diagrams). Exam: Mon 2 Nov (Visor) or Thu 5 Nov 2026 (Atenea), 15:00.
